[2026-08-08] A COMPRESSION GATE MUST MEASURE THE AUDIBLE BAND, not the full spectrum. Comparing peak (then full-band RMS) failed twelve takes as "destroyed", one by 18.8 dB. They were fine: level_up_lute is 97.2% ULTRASONIC with nothing at all between 4 and 16 kHz — the residue of the 2x-decode aliasing bug fixed on 08-06 — and opus was correctly throwing that away. Measuring below 16 kHz dropped the false failures from 12 to 5, and those 5 lose real audible level and keep their wav. THE BUG: a generator pushes art with GITHUB_TOKEN (which cannot trigger workflows) and then dispatches the deploy explicitly. workflow_dispatch records github.sha = whatever main pointed at when the dispatch was ACCEPTED, and actions/checkout defaults to that sha — so a push that landed one second earlier is not in the build. composer-foley pushed 20 sounds at 06:12:13 and dispatched at 06:12:14; the deploy built the previous tip, went GREEN, and all 20 files 404'd in the game while sitting on GitHub. Intermittent, silent, and it hits EVERY domain that pushes art then dispatches — characters2, tiles2, maps2, objects, monsters, items, sounds, music. THE FIX: a `resolve` job asks the API for main's tip, and both `test` and `build-deploy` check out that exact sha (and tag/stamp/deploy with it). Resolved once so the gate cannot test a different commit from the one that ships. Nothing to change on your side — your existing dispatch now lands.

[2026-08-05] MUSIC QUALITY BAR, for anyone generating background music: (1) LOUDNESS-MATCH beds or every cross-fade is a volume jump — measure BS.1770, do not eyeball. Careful: deriving K-weighting from RBJ cookbook formulas does NOT reproduce the standard (shelf 0.2577 dB low at 997 Hz = exactly how far the calibration tone then misses -3.01 LKFS); round-trip the tabulated 48k coefficients through their analog prototype. (2) SEARCH for loop points (spectral+level match, beat-snapped) — generated music never loops sample-perfect. (3) Ask for a tempo but MEASURE it, and expect autocorrelation to return a multiple (2x for night, 3/2x for title) — use the brief's BPM as a prior. (4) Generate lossless, master once, encode at the end. (5) Naming real IP/artists is a 400 ToS block; negative prompts backfire; say 'it starts immediately' or you get a fade-in the maintainer will reject.
